name: Baizhu
description: A composed and enigmatic physician who oversees Bubu Pharmacy with measured care. Baizhu understands the value of patience and uses his knowledge to heal both body and spirit.

name: Beidou
description: A fearless captain known for defying the odds and protecting her crew with unwavering resolve. Beidou's presence inspires courage, whether at sea or on the battlefield.

name: Chongyun
description: An earnest exorcist born with an excess of pure yang energy. Chongyun’s straightforward nature and hard work guide his mission to cleanse evil spirits.

name: Gaming
description: A lively martial artist who fights with flair and enthusiasm. Gaming values camaraderie and throws himself into every battle with burning energy.

name: Ganyu
description: A half-adeptus who serves Liyue with gentle determination and quiet diligence. Ganyu balances her heritage and duties with grace, always striving to support those around her.

name: Hu Tao
description: The playful director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who balances humor with deep understanding of life and death. Hu Tao brings warmth and sincerity to her work despite her eccentricity.

name: Keqing
description: A decisive leader of the Liyue Qixing who values human effort above divine intervention. Keqing acts swiftly once she makes a decision and always strives for excellence.

name: Lan Yan
description: A skilled investigator who traverses Liyue with quiet precision. Lan Yan trusts intuition and observation, solving problems with calm professionalism.

name: Ningguang
description: The influential Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing who commands respect through strategic brilliance. Ningguang approaches every decision with elegance and precision.

name: Qiqi
description: A polite, emotionless zombie revived through mystical means. Qiqi follows written reminders to manage her daily life and carries out tasks with quiet diligence.

name: Shenhe
description: Raised among the adepti, Shenhe carries a solemn aura shaped by isolation and intense training. Her strength is matched by a quiet grace that hints at her inner vulnerability.

name: Xiangling
description: An enthusiastic chef whose creativity and passion define her cooking. Xiangling embraces unusual ingredients with excitement, always seeking new culinary ideas.

name: Xianyun
description: An elegant adeptus who has taken a more grounded form to observe the world. Xianyun offers measured wisdom and maintains a serene outlook shaped by centuries of experience.

name: Xiao
description: A solitary adeptus who fights tirelessly to protect Liyue from ancient threats. Though distant, Xiao carries immense devotion beneath his stoic exterior.

name: Xingqiu
description: A refined young noble who cherishes literature and chivalric ideals. Xingqiu balances his studies with heroic aspirations, often acting with secret generosity.

name: Xinyan
description: A passionate rock ’n’ roll musician who spreads freedom through her performances. Xinyan is bold in personality and dedicated to expressing herself without restraint.

name: Yanfei
description: A brilliant legal advisor who upholds justice with clarity and enthusiasm. Yanfei enjoys solving disputes and ensures every contract is fair and precise.

name: Yaoyao
description: A cheerful adeptus-taught child who helps others with kindness and genuine care. Yaoyao navigates the world with curiosity and a protective spirit.

name: Yelan
description: A mysterious operative whose actions often remain hidden behind layers of secrecy. Yelan analyzes situations quickly and steps in only when absolutely necessary.

name: Yun Jin
description: A celebrated opera performer known for her artistry and discipline. Yun Jin brings tradition to life with expressive storytelling and graceful movement.

name: Zhongli
description: A calm consultant with vast knowledge of history and culture. Zhongli carries himself with elegance and wisdom, offering insight shaped by a long, mysterious past.
